records.rationale: In TopicEmbed.absolutize_urls, links/images are rewritten only when href/src starts_with?('/'), and the rewrite uses href.sub(/^\/+/, '') / src.sub(/^\/+/, '') (see fragment.css('a') and fragment.css('img')), which strips *all* leading slashes. This will incorrectly treat protocol-relative URLs like "//cdn.example.com/x.jpg" as if they were root-relative, mangling them into "{prefix}/cdn.example.c

records.issue_text: contents << "\n<hr>…" mutates the caller's string in place, appending the footer repeatedly on retry/reuse and raising FrozenError on frozen input
records.rationale: In TopicEmbed.import, the line `contents << "\n<hr>\n<small>..."` appends to the passed-in String in place. This is verifiable from the diff and can (a) add the footer multiple times if the caller reuses the same `contents` object across calls/retries, and (b) raise `FrozenError` if `contents` is frozen (e.g., immutable string input).

records.issue_text: The postMessage height call is inside window.onload, so the iframe height is sent exactly once and never updates as content loads
records.rationale: In layouts/embed.html.erb the resize postMessage is sent in window.onload, which fires after the embedded document (including images like avatars) finishes loading, so it is not true that it “never updates as content loads.” The diff does only send the height once (no MutationObserver/periodic resize), but the specific claim about load-time updates is not supported by the code shown.

records.issue_text: embed.js has no null check on document.getElementById('discourse-comments'), so comments.appendChild throws if the host page lacks that element
records.rationale: In newly added app/assets/javascripts/embed.js, `comments` is assigned from `document.getElementById('discourse-comments')` and then used unconditionally in `comments.appendChild(iframe);`. If the host page does not include an element with id `discourse-comments`, `comments` will be null and this will throw at runtime.

records.issue_text: discourseUrl + "embed/best?…" silently produces a broken URL unless the host page includes a trailing slash, which is undocumented
records.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/embed.js`, `iframe.src` is built via naive string concatenation: `discourseUrl + "embed/best?embed_url=" + ...`. If `discourseUrl` is provided without a trailing `/` (e.g. `https://forum.example.com`), the result becomes `https://forum.example.comembed/best?...`, which is an invalid/broken URL. feed_key computes a 'feed-modified:' cache key that is never read or written, so the intended conditional-GET/Last-Modified short-circuit is unimplemented dead code and every hourly run re-downloads the full feed
records.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, `feed_key` builds a Redis-style cache key (`"feed-modified:..."`) but is never referenced anywhere in the diff (no reads/writes to it, and `poll_feed` always does `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)`), so it is dead code and any intended short-circuit/caching behavior is indeed unimplemented.
